meta.name: amplitude-automation
meta.description: Automate Amplitude tasks via Rube MCP (Composio): events, user activity, cohorts, user identification. Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动完成 Amplitude 事件、用户分析和分群操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 Amplitude 中手动执行重复的数据操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate Amplitude events, user analysis, and cohort operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently perform repetitive data tasks in Amplitude

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你向 Amplitude 发送事件、查询用户活动、管理用户属性和人群，以及浏览事件类别。
howto.when: 当你要求追踪用户行为、查看某个用户的历史事件、更新用户属性或管理人群时触发。

say.text: 查询用户 user_456 在 Amplitude 中的活动记录。
say.note: Claude 会先查找用户再获取活动。

say.text: 列出 Amplitude 中所有已保存的人群。
say.note: Claude 会调用列出人群工具。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send events to Amplitude, query user activity, manage user properties and cohorts, and browse event categories.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to track user behavior, view a user's event history, update user properties, or manage cohorts.

say_en.text: Send a 'purchase' event to Amplitude for user user_123.
say_en.note: Claude will call the send events tool.

say_en.text: Get the activity history for user user_456 in Amplitude.
say_en.note: Claude will find the user then get activity.

say_en.text: List all saved cohorts in Amplitude.
say_en.note: Claude will call the list cohorts tool.
